name: Nodest – No-Code Automation and Workflow Builder for WordPress
author: Nodest

sections.description:
Nodest is a no-code automation platform built for WordPress users. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Nodest platform, allowing you to trigger automations based on WordPress events and execute actions directly on your site.

What you can do:

  • Build automations visually, without writing a single line of code
  • Connect to external tools and services through the Nodest platform
  • Manage all your automations and monitor executions from inside your WordPress admin

Requirements:

  • Nodest account — sign up at nodest.com
  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • HTTPS enabled on your site
  • REST API enabled on your site

External Service:

This plugin connects to the Nodest platform (app.nodest.com) to provide its automation functionality. By using this plugin, you agree to the Nodest Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nodest folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Nodest menu item in your WordPress admin
  4. Connect your site to your Nodest account
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nodest account?

Yes, a Nodest account is required. You can sign up for free at nodest.com.

Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Nodest works independently of your theme.

Is HTTPS required?

Yes, HTTPS is required for the secure connection between WordPress and Nodest.
